narratives.Description: [AppSec] HIGH ci-secrets-supply-02: npm trusted publish has no environment gate and fires on any v* tag
narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy (#5365 Prefer-A 6050330747)

1. Create GitHub Environment npm with reviewers + selected branch/tag refs; bind all four @deftai packages to trusted publisher; only then merge environment: npm workflow (YAML alone does not close).
2. Tighten on.push.tags to v*.*.*; validate SemVer / dist-tag before publish.
3. Dispatch/tag identity: resolve refs/tags/<name>, peel immutable SHA, verify master ancestry; constrain dispatch workflow ref separately from payload tag.
4. Split prepare/pack (no id-token) from OIDC publish job that consumes same-run tarballs only; no install/build/scripts in OIDC job.
5. Keep GitHub-hosted runner for provenance (forensics only).
6. Local authz:grant / task release stays complementary.
7. Forge tag-creation restriction on refs/tags/v* (ruleset creation control).

Ship order: limb 7 + 1a/1b first; then 1c + 2-3; limb 4 fast-follow allowed but Bound incomplete until it lands.
Reject B/C/D/E as sole closes.

AppSec remediation - Product: Directive (`deftai/directive`) - Finding: `ci-secrets-supply-02` - Severity: high - Scan: 2026-10-05 @ `d855dc0f784a24ed6d99cffd488a85f41d22431c` - Report: [2026-10-05 AppSec report § directive / ci-secrets-supply-02](https://github.com/deftai/appsec-scans/blob/3dd35fd7f6b54922c56759157c13c821b4374dec/reports/directive/2026-10-05/report.md#directive-ci-secrets-supply-02) ### Impact Anyone who can push tags (write, not merge-to-master) can tag a malicious commit `v99.0.0` and ship `@deftai/directive*` as `latest`.
Consumers and agents then install attacker-controlled CLI plus framework content.
A compromised install-time dependency in the same job can also request the publish OIDC token.
Remediation Add `environment: npm` with required reviewers and restricted refs (protected tags / default branch).
Bind the npm trusted publisher to that environment.
Refuse `workflow_dispatch` refs that are not annotated tags reachable from `master`.
Split install/build (`contents: read`, no `id-token`, `--ignore-scripts`) from a later publish job that is the only step with `id-token: write`.
Filed by the scheduled AppSec scan.
Do not close until the control is in the default branch.
The next weekly scan will comment here if this ID is still confirmed.
